faq.answer: Yes. Approved banking partners provide flexible No-Cost EMI plans: INR 6,382 / month for 12 months, INR 8,509 / month for 9 months, or INR 12,764 / month for 6 months (inclusive of 18% GST) with zero processing fees.

faq.question: What placement assistance and career support does Nova Skills provide?
faq.answer: Students receive comprehensive placement support: 1-on-1 portfolio reviews with agency creative directors, Behance case study audits, resume optimization, mock technical design interviews, and direct introductions to our corporate agency hiring network.

modules.module_purpose: Master the fundamental visual, psychological, and typographic laws governing effective commercial design, transforming raw creative instincts into disciplined visual problem-solving, structural grid layouts, and expressive typographic hierarchies.
what_you_will_learn: Deconstruct commercial design briefs, analyze target audiences, and execute divergent brainstorming using analog thumbnail sketches.
Apply Gestalt psychology (proximity, similarity, continuity, closure, figure/ground) to establish intuitive visual hierarchy and balance.
Master microtypography: optical kerning, tracking, leading, measure, and construct mathematical modular type scales.
Formulate certified commercial color palettes specifying exact sRGB, CMYK, and HEX values adhering to color psychology.
Build modular and baseline layout grid systems using proportional mechanics (Golden Ratio, Rule of Thirds) in digital canvas tools.

lessons.what_is_taught: The end-to-end commercial design process: deconstructing creative briefs, audience profiling, visual observation, divergent brainstorming, rapid thumbnail sketching, moodboarding, and art direction frameworks.
subtopics: Deconstructing commercial creative briefs and identifying core objectives
Observation, visual empathy, and user-centered visual problem-solving
Divergent brainstorming and analog thumbnail sketching techniques
Moodboarding, stylescapes, and visual direction synthesis
Reference gathering, mood curation, and inspiration attribution ethics
lessons.why_it_matters: Designers who skip thumbnail sketching and brief analysis produce generic, misaligned visuals. Systematic visual thinking ensures concepts solve real client communication problems before opening software.
lessons.what_learner_does: Analyze a design brief for an eco-conscious luxury brand; brainstorm 20 thumbnail sketches in 20 minutes, curate a focused 9-tile moodboard, and establish the visual tone of voice.
lessons.expected_outcome: A documented brief analysis sheet, thumbnail sketch sheet, and structured digital moodboard.
lessons.example: Translating a vague client request for 'modern premium feel' into concrete visual criteria: restrained monochrome palette, generous negative space, and refined high-contrast serif typography.

lessons.what_is_taught: Perceptual psychology in commercial layouts: Gestalt principles (Proximity, Similarity, Continuity, Closure, Figure/Ground), visual weight, optical vs geometric balance, focal hierarchy, and intentional negative space.
subtopics: Gestalt principles in commercial art direction and UI layouts
Symmetrical, asymmetrical, and radial balance
Positive vs negative space and optical breathing room
Directing eye movement: Visual cadence, rhythm, and reading patterns (F and Z patterns)
Contrast, repetition, and visual hierarchy frameworks
lessons.why_it_matters: Visual clutter repels audiences. Gestalt principles provide mathematical and psychological rules to organize complex visual elements into intuitive, instantly digestible compositions.
lessons.what_learner_does: Create 6 abstract compositional studies demonstrating Gestalt laws using strictly black-and-white geometric primitives; critique and refine based on optical balance.
lessons.expected_outcome: A 6-part Gestalt composition study demonstrating mastery of figure/ground, tension, balance, and focal point dominance.
lessons.example: Using negative space closure to form an implicit secondary shape inside an advertising poster headline.

lessons.what_is_taught: Comprehensive typographic science: anatomy of type, classification systems, microtypography (kerning pairs, tracking, leading, measure), font pairing harmony, and accessibility contrast standards.
subtopics: Type anatomy: Baselines, x-height, ascenders, descenders, counters, and serifs
Classification: Old Style, Modern, Slab, Humanist Sans, Geometric Sans, and Display
Microtypographic mechanics: Optical vs metric kerning, tracking ranges, and leading ratios
Modular type scales (Minor Third 1.200 to Golden Ratio 1.618) and visual hierarchy
Type pairing science: Contrast vs concord, mood alignment, and avoiding discordance
Readability, legibility, and WCAG accessibility contrast requirements
lessons.why_it_matters: Typography represents over 80% of commercial visual communication. Amateur kerning, poor line-height, and chaotic font choices instantly degrade brand credibility.
lessons.what_learner_does: Typeset a challenging editorial text excerpt; manually correct 10 difficult kerning pairs, establish a mathematical 5-level type hierarchy, and pair an expressive display serif with a functional geometric sans.
lessons.expected_outcome: A polished typographic specimen sheet displaying disciplined microtypographic execution and modular scale ratios.
lessons.example: Eliminating river gaps, orphaned single words, and unsightly hyphens in justified multi-column body text.

lessons.lesson_title: Color Theory, Technical Color Models & Grid Systems
lessons.what_is_taught: Color psychology and harmonies, technical color reproduction (additive RGB, subtractive CMYK, HEX web values, and Pantone spot colors), structural grid systems, and baseline rhythm alignment.
subtopics: Color wheel mechanics: Primary, secondary, tertiary hues, tints, tones, and shades
Color harmonies: Monochromatic, analogous, complementary, split-complementary, and triadic palettes
Color psychology and cultural semantics across commercial industries
Technical color models: RGB screen gamuts vs CMYK print gamuts, out-of-gamut clipping, and HEX
Structural grids: 12-column modular grids, baseline grids, rule of thirds, and proportional margins
lessons.why_it_matters: Mismatched color profiles result in dull, muddy print jobs and mismatched brand assets across digital and physical touchpoints. Mathematical grids guarantee layout consistency.
lessons.what_learner_does: Construct an 8pt baseline rhythm grid with a 12-column layout; define a certified 5-color brand palette specifying exact RGB, CMYK, and HEX values; typeset a poster adhering strictly to the grid.
lessons.expected_outcome: A production-accurate color palette specification and a grid-aligned poster composition with zero floating elements.
lessons.example: Converting a vibrant screen RGB teal into its closest reproducible CMYK formula without unintended color shifting.

modules.hands_on_practice: Analyze a creative brief, sketch 20 thumbnail ideas, configure an 8pt baseline layout grid, and construct a certified color harmony palette.
modules.assignment: Design an original typography-led commercial advertising poster and accompanying visual system exploration sheet with documented design decisions and moodboard references.
modules.business_application: Enables visual designers and creative leads to pitch coherent visual concepts backed by design psychology, modular type scales, and production-accurate color specifications.
modules.expected_outcome: Submitted typography poster and visual system exploration demonstrating clear hierarchy, balanced composition, microtypographic refinement, and concept originality.

modules.module_purpose: Master professional raster graphics production, advanced non-destructive layer hierarchies, complex selection/masking workflows, commercial product and skin retouching, multi-source photographic compositing, and controlled commercial Generative AI integration in Adobe Photoshop.
what_you_will_learn: Construct non-destructive Photoshop files using Smart Objects, Smart Filters, nested adjustment layers, and clipping masks.
Execute precision extractions: hard-surface vector clipping masks, transparent glass refractions, and complex fine-hair channel masks.
Perform commercial beauty and product retouching using Frequency Separation and non-destructive Dodge & Burn.
Build believable multi-source photographic composites with perspective alignment, contact shadows, and unified atmospheric lighting.
Integrate Adobe Firefly Generative Fill and Generative Expand to extend scenes while manually eliminating AI artifacts.
key_concepts: Pen Tool Vector Paths & Channel Masks

lessons.what_is_taught: Pixel-based imaging fundamentals: document resolution (72 vs 300 PPI), color settings, Smart Objects, Smart Filters, nested adjustment layers, clipping masks, and precision extraction tools.
subtopics: Pixel dimensions, optical resolution, resampling algorithms, and bit depth (8-bit vs 16-bit)
Non-destructive layer architecture: Smart Objects, Smart Filters, and adjustment layers
Pen Tool path extraction: Hard-surface vector masks for industrial products and architecture
Select and Mask workspace: Edge detection, smooth, feather, contrast, shift edge, and Decontaminate Colors
Advanced channel masking for fine hair, animal fur, transparent glass, and foliage
lessons.why_it_matters: Destructive pixel editing permanently destroys source image data, making client revisions impossible. Agency-grade Photoshop files demand 100% reversible, non-destructive layer structures.
lessons.what_learner_does: Extract two complex subjects: a luxury watch with metallic bevels using Pen Tool vector masks, and a model with flyaway hair against a noisy background using channel masks.
lessons.expected_outcome: Flawlessly isolated subjects with clean alpha channels, zero background fringing, and fully editable vector/raster layer masks.
lessons.example: Preserving semi-transparent liquid refraction inside an amber glass perfume bottle while replacing its studio backdrop.

lessons.what_is_taught: High-end commercial skin and product retouching: Frequency Separation (high-frequency texture vs low-frequency tone/color), non-destructive Dodge & Burn, blemish removal, and surface reconstruction.
subtopics: Frequency Separation setup: Splitting high-frequency texture and low-frequency color/tone
Texture cleanup: Healing Brush and Clone Stamp techniques preserving 100% natural pore texture
Non-destructive Dodge and Burn using 50% neutral gray and Curves adjustment layers
Commercial packshot finishing: Removing scratches, seam lines, dust, and uneven reflections
Color correction: Curves, Levels, Color Balance, and neutralizing unwanted color casts
lessons.why_it_matters: Over-retouched, plastic-looking skin or blurry product packshots destroy consumer trust. Professional retouching enhances appeal while maintaining photographic authenticity.
lessons.what_learner_does: Retouch a close-up commercial beauty portrait using Frequency Separation and Dodge & Burn; clean a product packshot removing industrial seams and specular flaws.
lessons.expected_outcome: A commercial-standard beauty portrait and clean product packshot with perfectly even tonal transitions and intact surface texture.
lessons.example: Removing acne redness on the low-frequency layer while leaving the skin's natural microscopic pore texture completely untouched on the high-frequency layer.

lessons.what_is_taught: Constructing believable multi-image advertising composites: horizon line alignment, Vanishing Point perspective, contact/cast shadow construction, specular highlights, and atmospheric blending.
subtopics: Perspective matching: Setting horizon lines, vanishing points, and camera focal lengths across separate photos
Perspective Warp and Free Transform for matching three-dimensional geometry
Shadow physics: Constructing contact shadows, ambient occlusion, and directional cast shadow falloff
Lighting reconstruction: Matching directional key lights, fill lights, and rim highlights
Atmospheric depth: Atmospheric haze, depth maps, particle effects, and cinematic color grading with LUTs
lessons.why_it_matters: Inconsistent light angles, missing contact shadows, or mismatched camera perspectives immediately reveal an amateur composite. Commercial realism requires strict adherence to physical lighting laws.
lessons.what_learner_does: Combine 5 separate photographic assets (environment, foreground product, model, atmospheric smoke, and lighting effects) into a seamless commercial key visual with custom shadows and unified grading.
lessons.expected_outcome: A photorealistic composite visual where all disparate elements appear captured in a single camera exposure.
lessons.example: Painting multi-layered cast shadows using Gaussian blur gradients that soften progressively as distance from the object increases.

lessons.lesson_title: Controlled Generative AI Workflows & Production Exports
lessons.what_is_taught: Integrating Adobe Firefly generative tools within commercial Photoshop pipelines: Generative Fill, Generative Expand, Generate Background, mask-based inpainting, artifact cleanup, Content Credentials, and production export prep.
subtopics: Generative Fill and Generative Expand: Prompt craft for seamless background expansion and object insertion
Generate Background and Harmonize: Blending subject lighting automatically with generated environments
Mask-based refinement: Combining AI generation with manual masking, clone stamping, and grain matching
Resolving AI artifacts: Correcting anatomical errors, texture smudges, and repetitive noise patterns
Source-image licensing, Content Credentials (C2PA) provenance, PSD layer organization, and multi-format web/print export
lessons.why_it_matters: Pure AI generation lacks composition control and creates telltale artifacts. Combining AI speed with manual Photoshop retouching creates stunning, commercially safe deliverables.
lessons.what_learner_does: Take a product packshot on a tight crop; use Generative Expand to convert it into a 16:9 banner; clean up generated background artifacts manually, match photographic grain, and export optimized assets.
lessons.expected_outcome: A high-resolution advertising key visual seamlessly extended with Generative AI and manually perfected with non-destructive adjustment layers.
lessons.example: Using Generative Fill to replace an empty concrete floor with reflective polished marble, followed by manual painting of specular highlights and contact shadows.

modules.hands_on_practice: Isolate complex subjects with channel masks, execute commercial Frequency Separation, and composite multi-source assets with perspective-matched shadows.
modules.assignment: Create a premium product-advertising key visual through multi-source photographic compositing, custom lighting/shadow construction, manual masking, and controlled AI Generative Fill.
modules.business_application: Prepares students for roles as visual retouchers, commercial compositors, and digital advertising designers producing campaign key visuals for global brands.
modules.expected_outcome: Submitted layered PSD file demonstrating photorealism, lighting consistency, clean edges, editable Smart Objects, and high production quality.

modules.module_purpose: Master precision vector mathematics, anchor point economy, geometric construction grids, custom typography modification, cohesive iconography systems, responsive logo lockups, and controlled vector generative AI in Adobe Illustrator.
what_you_will_learn: Draw precision Bezier curves adhering strictly to the Anchor Point Economy rule with extrema handle alignment.
Engineer geometric brand marks using circular grids, Golden Ratio calipers, and Shape Builder / Pathfinder operations.
Design a unified 12-piece iconography library on a 24x24px optical grid with consistent stroke weight and radii.
Construct complete responsive logo suites: primary mark, horizontal lockup, stacked mark, and 16px favicon.
Harness Illustrator generative features (Text to Vector, Generative Recolor, Pattern) with manual vector cleanup.

lessons.lesson_title: Precision Pen Tool Mastery & Anchor Point Economy
lessons.what_is_taught: Vector geometry foundations: mathematical Bezier curves, anchor point types (corner, smooth, symmetrical), the Anchor Point Economy rule, Curvature Tool, Shape Builder, and Pathfinder operations.
subtopics: Mathematical foundations of Bezier curves: Tangent handles, direction lines, and curve tension
The Anchor Point Economy rule: Placing points strictly at vertical and horizontal extrema
Pen Tool and Curvature Tool speed workflows for organic and industrial silhouettes
Pathfinder operations vs Shape Builder Tool: Unite, Minus Front, Intersect, Exclude, and Divide
Offset Path mechanics for consistent internal line weights, borders, and negative-space cutouts
lessons.why_it_matters: Excessive or improperly placed anchor points create lumpy curves, jagged plot cuts, bloated file sizes, and rendering glitches in digital displays and CNC/die-cut machinery.
lessons.what_learner_does: Complete the Bezier Curve tracing challenge: accurately trace 5 complex organic shapes and technical logos using strictly the minimum necessary anchor points placed at curve extrema.
lessons.expected_outcome: A vector artboard displaying perfectly smooth curves with anchor points placed only at 12, 3, 6, and 9 o'clock extrema with horizontal/vertical handles.
lessons.example: Drawing a perfect teardrop shape using only 3 anchor points instead of 15 messy points.

lessons.what_is_taught: Engineering geometrically balanced brand marks: circular grid systems, Golden Ratio calipers, isometric grids, optical corrections, and custom vector typography modification.
subtopics: Constructing circular and modular grid matrices for brand marks
The Golden Ratio and proportional harmony in symbol design
Optical corrections in logo design: Correcting geometric vs optical visual weight and alignments
Custom typography styling: Converting type to outlines, slicing, modifying stems, and ligature crafting
Designing monograms, abstract symbols, wordmarks, and combination marks
lessons.why_it_matters: Great logos are not drawn freehand; they are engineered with mathematical and optical rigor so they remain timeless, memorable, and balanced at any reproduction scale.
lessons.what_learner_does: Engineer an iconic animal or abstract brand symbol using overlapping circular grids, the Shape Builder tool, and Golden Ratio proportions, accompanied by custom modified wordmark typography.
lessons.expected_outcome: A master logo construction sheet showing underlying circular construction grids, unmerged geometry, and final merged production vectors.
lessons.example: Applying optical overshoot so a circular logo mark aligns visually with adjacent square and triangular brand elements.

lessons.what_is_taught: Building cohesive multi-piece icon libraries and complex vector illustrations: Appearance panel, multiple strokes/fills, Freeform Gradients, Gradient Mesh, patterns, and dynamic brushes.
subtopics: Designing cohesive 12-piece icon systems on a 24x24px optical grid with 2px stroke rules
Pixel-grid alignment and crisp rendering at small physical screen sizes
Appearance panel architecture: Stacking dynamic strokes, fills, and non-destructive vector effects
Volumetric vector shading using Freeform Gradients, Gradient Mesh, and opacity masks
Creating seamless vector patterns, custom art brushes, and symbol libraries
lessons.why_it_matters: Inconsistent icon sets (mixed line weights, conflicting corner radii, varying optical visual mass) instantly break user interface and brand cohesion.
lessons.what_learner_does: Design a 12-piece icon set for a fintech or e-commerce platform adhering to strict stroke, corner radius, and optical mass parameters; construct a multi-color seamless pattern.
lessons.expected_outcome: A 12-piece unified vector icon library aligned to the pixel grid and an editable seamless brand pattern.
lessons.example: Setting optical padding so a play-arrow icon appears centered inside a circle even though its bounding box is geometrically off-center.

lessons.lesson_title: Logo Suite Architecture, Generative Vector AI & Production QA
lessons.what_is_taught: Full commercial logo suites: responsive logo variants (primary, stacked, sub-mark, favicon), clear space rules, black-and-white testing, Illustrator Generative AI features, and vector quality assurance.
subtopics: Anatomy of a complete logo suite: Primary lockup, horizontal lockup, stacked mark, and 16px favicon
Defining clear space exclusion zones and minimum reproduction dimensions (print mm vs digital px)
Black-and-white and single-color contrast testing for embroidery, embossing, and fax reproduction
Adobe Firefly vector features: Text to Vector Graphic, Concept to Vector, Text to Pattern, and Generative Recolor
Vector QA preflight: Expand appearance, outline strokes, remove stray points, close open paths, and export clean SVGs
lessons.why_it_matters: An identity that only works in full color on a white screen fails in the real world. Brands require responsive variants, rigorous single-color testing, and clean vector hygiene for production.
lessons.what_learner_does: Assemble a complete responsive logo suite; test in positive/negative single-color; generate 4 seasonal colorways using Generative Recolor; clean all vector paths for SVG export.
lessons.expected_outcome: A production-ready vector logo pack containing primary, horizontal, stacked, mark, and favicon SVGs free of stray points and unexpanded strokes.
lessons.example: Outlining all live typographic strokes and fonts before exporting client EPS and SVG files to prevent missing font errors at print shops.

modules.hands_on_practice: Construct circular geometric grids, practice anchor point economy, build a 12-piece icon set, and test single-color logo contrast.
modules.assignment: Create a professional brand identity mark suite (primary, stacked, monogram, favicon) and a coordinated 12-piece vector icon library with underlying construction grids.
modules.business_application: Prepares students to operate as specialized brand identity designers, vector illustrators, and logo engineers commanding premium agency branding rates.
modules.expected_outcome: Submitted Illustrator master file featuring visible construction grids, unexpanded master art, production-ready expanded marks, and optimized SVG asset exports.

modules.module_purpose: Bridge commercial brand strategy with comprehensive visual identity design, formulating brand foundations, positioning frameworks, complete logo suites, color governance, typography hierarchies, and agency-grade corporate Brand Guidelines manuals.
what_you_will_learn: Conduct strategic client discovery workshops, establish brand archetypes, and synthesize actionable creative briefs.
Design a complete responsive logo suite with mathematical exclusion zones and minimum scale specifications.
Engineer a production-accurate corporate color system providing certified HEX, RGB, CMYK, and Pantone PMS codes.
Design branded corporate stationery, business cards with specialty finishes, and social media template kits.
Compile and layout an agency-standard 20+ page corporate Brand Guidelines manual in Adobe InDesign and Figma.
key_concepts: Brand Archetypes & Visual Tone of Voice

lessons.lesson_title: Strategic Brand Discovery, Positioning & Brand DNA
lessons.what_is_taught: Deconstructing commercial brand foundations: target customer personas, competitive landscape audits, market positioning matrices, brand personality archetypes, and tone of voice.
subtopics: Conducting strategic client discovery workshops and extracting core business goals
Defining brand purpose, vision, mission, core values, and Brand DNA
Jungian brand personality archetypes and their visual translation
Competitive benchmarking, perceptual mapping, and identifying the brand's 'White Space'
Developing the brand voice, messaging pillars, and evaluating naming and taglines with ChatGPT
lessons.why_it_matters: Visual identity without strategic foundation is purely subjective decoration. Strategic positioning gives design decisions defensible commercial business value.
lessons.what_learner_does: Formulate the complete strategic brand foundation for a real or simulated disruptor brand, including positioning matrix and brand archetype.
lessons.expected_outcome: A 6-page Strategic Brand Brief articulating brand vision, archetype, audience personas, and positioning matrix.
lessons.example: Positioning an organic skincare brand as 'The Sage' (scientific, minimalist, clinical trust) rather than 'The Lover' (sensual, emotional luxury).

lessons.lesson_title: Visual Identity Systems, Color Governance & Typography Hierarchy
lessons.what_is_taught: Engineering the complete visual language: responsive logo suite, certified color governance (HEX, RGB, CMYK, Pantone PMS), official typography standards, and supporting graphic assets.
subtopics: Responsive logo suite engineering: Primary lockup, secondary stacked, monogram mark, and 16px favicon
Defining clear space exclusion zones and minimum reproduction physical sizes
Color palette architecture: Primary, secondary, neutral, and semantic accent colors
Certified color specifications: Matching RGB screen values to CMYK print formulas and Pantone Solid Coated swatches
Typography hierarchy: Primary brand display face, secondary body face, and web font fallbacks
lessons.why_it_matters: Brands lose visual consistency when color codes are guessed or type scales lack rules. Certified Pantone codes and strict exclusion zones ensure identical brand reproduction worldwide.
lessons.what_learner_does: Develop the full visual system for the capstone brand; establish certified Pantone PMS codes for all brand colors, and construct a 5-level typographic hierarchy with defined leading.
lessons.expected_outcome: A master visual identity specification sheet containing responsive logos, clear space rules, certified color swatches, and typographic scales.
lessons.example: Selecting Pantone 286 C for print and deriving its exact mathematical sRGB (#0033A0) and CMYK (100/75/0/0) equivalents to guarantee color fidelity.

lessons.what_is_taught: Designing commercial brand collateral: business cards, corporate stationery, envelopes, presentation folders, social media kit templates, packaging touchpoints, and realistic mockups.
subtopics: Corporate stationery design: Letterheads, business cards, envelopes, and email signatures
Paper stock selection: Coated vs uncoated papers, paper weights (GSM), and tactile finishes
Social media profile identity systems: Avatars, profile banners, story highlights, and post templates
Designing custom supporting brand elements: Supergraphics, patterns, badges, and textures
Rendering commercial touchpoints into high-resolution photorealistic mockups in Photoshop
lessons.why_it_matters: Clients evaluate brand identities through physical and digital touchpoints. High-fidelity collateral mockups prove how the brand lives in the real commercial environment.
lessons.what_learner_does: Design a corporate stationery suite (business card with spot finish, letterhead, presentation folder) and a cohesive 5-piece social media template kit; present in realistic 3D mockups.
lessons.expected_outcome: A complete collateral design suite rendered in photorealistic context showing real-world brand applications.
lessons.example: Designing a luxury business card with matte soft-touch laminate and Gold Foil stamping on a 450 GSM black cotton paper stock.

lessons.lesson_title: Authoring the Comprehensive Brand Guidelines Manual
lessons.what_is_taught: Structuring, layout, and publishing an agency-standard corporate Brand Guidelines manual (Brand Book) in Adobe InDesign and Figma, covering governance, misuse rules, and asset handoff.
subtopics: Structure of an agency Brand Manual: DNA, Logo Governance, Color, Typography, Assets, and Applications
Specifying incorrect logo usage and brand violations (stretching, unapproved colors, low contrast)
Documenting photography art direction, model demographics, lighting styles, and tone of voice
Accessibility compliance: Documenting WCAG contrast compliance for digital brand applications
Compiling, packaging, and exporting interactive digital PDF/X and client cloud asset repositories
lessons.why_it_matters: Without a comprehensive Brand Manual, internal marketing teams and external agencies will quickly distort and fragment the brand identity.
lessons.what_learner_does: Typeset and layout a 20+ page corporate Brand Guidelines manual in Adobe InDesign/Figma, covering all identity rules, color specifications, and brand applications; export client-ready PDF.
lessons.expected_outcome: A polished 20+ page corporate Brand Guidelines manual ready for client executive handoff.
lessons.example: Documenting that the primary logo must never be displayed over busy photography without an approved semi-transparent dark scrim overlay.

modules.hands_on_practice: Conduct brand discovery, define brand archetypes, build responsive logo suites, certify Pantone color codes, and assemble stationery suites.
modules.assignment: Build a complete commercial visual identity system and an agency-grade 20+ page Brand Guidelines manual including brand strategy, logo suite, stationery, and mockups.
modules.business_application: Empowers designers to deliver high-ticket corporate brand identity retainers ($3,000–$10,000) for startups, SME clients, and enterprise agencies.
modules.expected_outcome: Submitted 20+ page Brand Guidelines PDF and accompanying presentation deck demonstrating strategy-to-design alignment, identity coherence, and production rigor.

modules.module_purpose: Master commercial advertising psychology, direct-response performance ad design, multi-platform digital creative suites, high-converting social carousels, large-format outdoor (OOH) billboards, and rapid creative batch production.
what_you_will_learn: Deconstruct advertising briefs, articulate compelling campaign concepts, and design stop-scrolling hero Key Visuals.
Adapt a master advertising visual across multi-platform aspect ratios (1:1, 9:16, 4:5, 16:9) adhering strictly to UI safe zones.
Design engaging seamless panoramic carousels and dynamic promotional templates for social feeds.
Calculate viewing distance resolution requirements and engineer large-format outdoor (OOH) billboards.
Structure batch creative production pipelines using Figma components and Photoshop Smart Objects.
key_concepts: Platform UI Safe Zones & Mobile Readability

lessons.lesson_title: Campaign Strategy, Visual Hooks & Key Visuals
lessons.what_is_taught: Commercial advertising strategy: deconstructing campaign briefs, audience hooks, visual storytelling, the '3-second thumb-stopping rule', headline and CTA psychology, and designing the master Key Visual (KV).
subtopics: Deconstructing advertising briefs: Campaign objectives (awareness, acquisition, retargeting)
The psychology of visual hooks, pattern interrupts, and thumb-stopping feed mechanics
Anatomy of high-converting ads: Hook visual, value proposition, proof elements, and primary CTA
Developing the Campaign Key Visual (KV): Hero imagery, visual metaphors, and art direction
Brainstorming headline and CTA variations with ChatGPT and testing visual hooks
lessons.why_it_matters: In digital feeds, users scroll through hundreds of feet of content daily. Ads that fail to stop the thumb within 3 seconds generate zero return on ad spend (ROAS).
lessons.what_learner_does: Develop a compelling advertising concept for a product launch; design a high-impact master Key Visual featuring strong visual contrast, benefit-driven headline, and clear CTA.
lessons.expected_outcome: A master Campaign Key Visual poster establishing the visual benchmark for the entire multi-channel advertising rollout.
lessons.example: Creating a visual metaphor where a noise-canceling headphone literally silences chaotic city traffic turning it into calm pastel smoke.

lessons.lesson_title: Omni-Channel Digital Creative Suites & Safe Zones
lessons.what_is_taught: Multi-platform adaptation: resizing master concepts across standard digital aspect ratios (1:1 feed, 9:16 vertical stories/reels, 4:5 portrait, 16:9 landscape), platform-compliant safe zones, and component batching.
subtopics: Aspect ratio standards: 1:1 Feed (1080x1080), 9:16 Stories/Reels (1080x1920), 4:5 Portrait (1080x1350), 16:9 Landscape (1200x628)
Platform safe zones: Avoiding UI overlay interference on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube
Responsive hierarchy reflow: Re-arranging headlines, logos, and product packshots without losing impact
Component-based creative batching in Figma and Photoshop Smart Objects for rapid resizing
Export specifications: JPEG/WebP compression, file size ceilings (<500 KB), and color space (sRGB)
lessons.why_it_matters: Marketing teams run ads across Meta, TikTok, Google, and LinkedIn simultaneously. Designers must quickly adapt hero concepts across all formats without critical text being cut off by platform UI.
lessons.what_learner_does: Take the master Key Visual and adapt it into a 4-piece digital ad suite (1:1, 9:16, 4:5, 16:9), ensuring 100% adherence to platform safe zones and typographic legibility.
lessons.expected_outcome: A complete multi-size digital advertising suite formatted and compressed for instant media-buyer upload.
lessons.example: Moving the primary CTA and brand mark inside the central 80% safe zone of a 9:16 Story ad so it is not obscured by the profile header or comment bar.

lessons.what_is_taught: Designing high-engagement educational and promotional social formats: seamless panoramic carousels, comparison charts, infographics, and dynamic animated display banners.
subtopics: Anatomy of a seamless panoramic carousel: Continuous visual flows across slide boundaries
Carousel storytelling arcs: Hook slide, problem amplification, value delivery, social proof, and CTA slide
Designing comparison charts, feature matrices, and digestible infographic data nuggets
Figma Auto-Layout carousel templates for scalable social content production
Creating animated GIF and HTML5 display banner adaptations with lightweight motion hooks
lessons.why_it_matters: Multi-slide carousels generate significantly higher engagement and algorithmic reach on LinkedIn and Instagram than static single images, driving organic and paid conversions.
lessons.what_learner_does: Design a seamless 7-slide panoramic Instagram carousel where visual elements flow continuously across slide borders, breaking down a complex product story into engaging visual slides.
lessons.expected_outcome: A seamless 7-slide carousel exported as individual slides ready for publishing, accompanied by an interactive Figma prototype.
lessons.example: Slicing a wide 7560x1080px panorama canvas into 7 seamless 1080x1080px slides where a central product illustration bridges slides 3 and 4.

lessons.what_is_taught: Engineering large-format outdoor advertising: highway billboards, bus shelter posters, subway wraps, viewing distance DPI formulas, large-format prepress setup, and photorealistic client mockups.
subtopics: The 5-Second Billboard Test: High-contrast typography, 7 words or fewer, and single focal point imagery
Viewing distance resolution formula: Calculating required DPI based on observer distance
Document setup for large-format: Scaling ratios (1:10 scale at 300 DPI vs 1:1 scale at 30-72 DPI)
Prepress considerations for vinyl banners, backlit transit shelters, and billboard illumination
Compositing outdoor mockups into photorealistic urban environments with perspective and weather effects
lessons.why_it_matters: Billboards read from high-speed highway traffic require radically different typographic scale and visual brevity than handheld phone screens. Incorrect resolution setup can ruin expensive print runs.
lessons.what_learner_does: Design a large-format highway billboard adhering to the 5-second test; composite it into a realistic urban city street mockup using displacement maps and realistic lighting.
lessons.expected_outcome: A print-ready large-format billboard file at correct scale and a high-impact photorealistic environmental client mockup.
lessons.example: Designing a highway billboard at 1:10 scale (4.8 ft x 1.4 ft at 300 DPI) that outputs cleanly to a full 48 ft x 14 ft outdoor vinyl print.

modules.hands_on_practice: Analyze ad creative briefs, construct multi-aspect ratio digital ad sets, design seamless carousels, and render urban OOH mockups.
modules.assignment: Create one integrated advertising campaign featuring a master Key Visual, multi-size digital ad suite (1:1, 9:16, 4:5, 16:9), a 7-slide seamless social carousel, and an urban outdoor billboard mockup.
modules.business_application: Prepares students for high-demand roles as performance ad designers, growth marketing creative leads, and digital advertising production artists.
modules.expected_outcome: Submitted advertising campaign package demonstrating strong visual hooks, consistent campaign identity, strict safe-zone compliance, and production-ready asset exports.

modules.module_purpose: Master professional publication design, multi-page editorial hierarchies, typography automation with Paragraph/Character/GREP styles, master/parent page architecture, preflight auditing, and ISO-compliant prepress print-ready PDF packaging in Adobe InDesign.
what_you_will_learn: Configure multi-page document architecture with spreads, facing pages, baseline grids, and 3mm exterior bleeds.
Build master/parent page hierarchies with dynamic running headers, chapter markers, and automatic folio numbering.
Automate complex typographic styling using cascading Paragraph Styles, Character Styles, nested styles, and GREP expressions.
Design dynamic editorial layouts with threaded text flows, baseline snapping, drop caps, and contour text wrap around silhouettes.
Conduct live preflight audits, resolve overset text and link errors, and package certified prepress PDF/X-4 print archives.
key_concepts: Color Space Separation (CMYK, Spot, Rich Black)

lessons.lesson_title: InDesign Workspace, Spreads & Parent Page Architecture
lessons.what_is_taught: Professional document architecture: facing pages, spreads, signature binding considerations (saddle stitch vs perfect bound), margin systems, column grids, baseline grids, 3mm exterior bleeds, slug areas, and Parent (Master) Pages.
subtopics: Facing pages, spreads, page numbering, margins, columns, and 3mm exterior bleeds
Parent Page architecture: Setting up multi-parent page hierarchies for covers, chapter dividers, and article layouts
Dynamic page numbering (folios), running headers, section markers, and chapter prefixes
Baseline grid configuration: Snapping body copy to uniform baseline rhythm across spreads
Binding considerations: Creep compensation for saddle-stitch and spine width calculation for perfect bound books
lessons.why_it_matters: Manually applying page numbers or headers across a 48-page publication wastes hours and invites errors. Parent pages and baseline grids automate document consistency across hundreds of pages.
lessons.what_learner_does: Set up a 16-page editorial publication document with parent pages for covers, feature articles, and interview spreads; configure automatic folios and a global 12pt baseline grid.
lessons.expected_outcome: A structured multi-page InDesign template with working parent pages, running headers, automatic folios, and baseline grid alignment.
lessons.example: Configuring Parent Page 'B-Feature' so all child pages inherit uniform running headers and folio numbers while allowing override of background imagery.

lessons.lesson_title: Automated Editorial Typography, Styles & GREP Expressions
lessons.what_is_taught: Industrial-grade typography automation: Paragraph Styles, Character Styles, style inheritance (Based On), nested styles, and GREP (regular expression) automated formatting for long manuscripts.
subtopics: Paragraph Styles vs Character Styles: Architecture, cascading inheritance, and override hygiene
Advanced OpenType features: True small caps, discretionary ligatures, tabular figures, and fractions
Nested styles: Automatically formatting lead-in run-in heads and drop caps
GREP styles: Writing regular expressions to format dates, phone numbers, currency symbols, and acronyms automatically
Text frame options: Multi-column frames, first baseline offset, vertical justification, and baseline snapping
lessons.why_it_matters: Manually styling thousands of words of manuscript text is unsustainable. GREP and nested styles format complex text automatically, saving days of repetitive clerical typesetting.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build an automated typographic stylesheet in InDesign; author 4 GREP expressions that automatically style currency, acronyms, and citations; typeset a multi-column article with zero overrides.
lessons.expected_outcome: A robust InDesign style library with cascading Paragraph, Character, and GREP styles formatting raw text instantly upon pasting.
lessons.example: Using the GREP string `\b[A-Z]{2,}\b` to automatically apply a Character Style with tracking +50 and 80% small-cap scaling to all uppercase acronyms.

lessons.lesson_title: Editorial Layout Dynamics, Visual Pacing & Content Flow
lessons.what_is_taught: Editorial layout design: pacing and rhythm across spreads, threaded text frames, primary text flows, image placement, text wrap contours around silhouettes, pull quotes, sidebars, and styled tables.
subtopics: Pacing and visual rhythm: Alternating text-dense spreads with image-heavy breathers
Threaded text frames and primary text flows for multi-page manuscript import
Text wrap options: Bounding box, contour wrap around object clipping paths/alpha channels, and invert wrap
Designing editorial sidebars, callout boxes, pull quotes, author bios, and footnotes
Table design: Alternating row colors, cell padding, headers, and importing structured CSV/Excel data
lessons.why_it_matters: Readers abandon publications that feel monotonous or disorienting. Visual pacing, dynamic pull quotes, and elegant image wraps keep readers engaged across multi-page articles.
lessons.what_learner_does: Design a dynamic 8-page feature article for an architecture or design publication; thread a 2,000-word text flow; wrap text around an extracted silhouette; insert pull quotes and styled data tables.
lessons.expected_outcome: A visually captivating 8-page editorial feature spread exhibiting harmonious visual pacing, zero text overset errors, and refined layout dynamics.
lessons.example: Wrapping multi-column body text tightly around the organic curve of an architectural building silhouette using Photoshop alpha channel clipping paths.

lessons.lesson_title: Preflight Auditing, Color Management & Print-Ready PDF Packaging
lessons.what_is_taught: Prepress quality assurance: Live Preflight panel configuration, link management, resolving missing fonts/links, CMYK color profiles, ink coverage (TAC <= 300%), packaging archives, and exporting certified PDF/X-1a and PDF/X-4 files.
subtopics: Live Preflight panel: Setting custom profiles to catch overset text, low-res images (<300 DPI), and RGB color spaces
Links panel management: Relinking modified assets, updating paths, and embedding vs linking best practices
Color management: Converting RGB assets to CMYK FOGRA39 / GRACoL, rich black rules, and total ink limit (TAC <= 300%)
Packaging publication archives: Collecting fonts, high-res linked images, and generating automated instruction reports
PDF export presets: Commercial print standards (PDF/X-1a vs PDF/X-4), crop marks, bleeds, and digital interactive PDF export
lessons.why_it_matters: Overset text, missing image links, or RGB color spaces cause massive financial losses and reprints at commercial offset print shops. Preflight certification guarantees error-free printing.
lessons.what_learner_does: Run a comprehensive preflight audit on a complete publication; fix 5 simulated errors (overset text, RGB image, missing font); package the document archive and export an ISO-compliant PDF/X-4.
lessons.expected_outcome: A fully packaged InDesign publication folder containing fonts, linked CMYK assets, and a certified print-ready PDF/X-4 with crop marks and 3mm bleeds.
lessons.example: Catching and resolving a hidden 3-line text overset overflow inside an article frame before sending the file to the commercial printer.

modules.hands_on_practice: Configure parent page folios, author automated GREP typographic styles, thread multi-page text flows, and preflight publications against print errors.
modules.assignment: Create a professional multi-page product brochure, lookbook, or editorial publication (minimum 12 pages) featuring parent pages, automated stylesheets, styled tables, and a certified print-ready PDF/X-4.
modules.business_application: Prepares students for roles as editorial designers, publishing production artists, and catalog production specialists in magazines, book publishers, and corporate communication departments.
modules.expected_outcome: Submitted packaged InDesign publication archive with verified high-res linked assets, fonts, and an error-free prepress PDF/X-4 file.

modules.module_purpose: Master structural packaging graphics, folding carton dielines, label design, typography at small physical scales, spot color separations, and photorealistic 3D packaging visualization without claiming structural engineering or legal compliance expertise.
what_you_will_learn: Deconstruct structural packaging types: straight tuck-end boxes, reverse tuck-end cartons, labels, pouches, and sleeves.
Construct technical dielines in Adobe Illustrator featuring precise cut lines, crease lines, glue flaps, and 3mm exterior bleeds.
Layout the Principal Display Panel (PDP) and side panels adhering to information hierarchy and barcode quiet zones.
Prepare certified prepress spot color separations for Pantone PMS, Spot UV varnish, and Hot Foil stamping layers set to Overprint.
Render flat 2D packaging artwork into photorealistic 3D product packshots in Photoshop for client commercial presentation.
key_concepts: Technical Dieline Anatomy (Cut, Crease, Glue, Bleed)
Prepress Spot Colors (Pantone, Spot UV, Foil)

lessons.what_is_taught: Structural packaging engineering principles: primary vs secondary packaging, paperboard substrates (SBS, kraft, corrugated), structural carton dielines, cut lines, crease/score lines, glue flaps, and dedicated non-printing dieline layers.
subtopics: Primary, secondary, and tertiary packaging definitions and commercial shelf objectives
Packaging substrates: SBS paperboard, kraft, rigid boxes, flexible film pouches, and glass labels
Dieline stroke conventions: Cut lines (solid magenta), crease/score lines (dashed cyan), and perforations
Glue tab engineering, tuck flap clearances, and establishing 3mm-5mm exterior bleeds
Placing dieline geometry on a dedicated, locked, non-printing layer named DIELINE - DO NOT PRINT
lessons.why_it_matters: A dieline error of even 1 millimeter will cause folding boxes to buckle, glue tabs to fail, or white paper edges to show after machine die-cutting, resulting in total commercial batch rejection.
lessons.what_learner_does: Construct a technical vector dieline for a reverse tuck-end (RTE) retail carton in Illustrator, configuring cut lines, crease scores, glue flaps, and exterior bleed.
lessons.expected_outcome: A precision vector dieline template on a dedicated non-printing spot layer with accurate folding and tuck clearances.
lessons.example: Setting crease lines as dashed strokes on a spot color layer so the commercial die-maker creates scoring rules rather than cutting blades.

lessons.what_is_taught: Designing commercial packaging faces: Principal Display Panel (PDP) visual hierarchy, brand mark placement, product claims, legal/client-supplied copy blocks, small-size typography legibility, and barcode standards.
subtopics: Principal Display Panel (PDP): Brand mark, product title, descriptor, net weight/volume, and hero imagery
Information hierarchy across top, side, and back panels: Ingredients, directions, and certifications
Micro-typography at small physical sizes: Minimum x-heights, avoiding ink fill-in, and tracking open
Barcode integration: EAN-13 / UPC barcode dimensions, contrast requirements, and mandatory quiet zones
Client-supplied regulatory copy: Placing mandatory nutrition tables, recycling badges, and warnings without legal liability
lessons.why_it_matters: Consumers spend an average of 4 seconds evaluating retail shelves. The PDP must communicate brand and product benefit instantly, while back panels must remain legible even at 6pt type.
lessons.what_learner_does: Design the complete artwork across all 6 panels of a folding retail carton; typeset nutrition/ingredient tables and insert a scannable EAN-13 barcode with verified quiet zones.
lessons.expected_outcome: A complete retail carton layout demonstrating clear PDP impact, scannable barcode placement, and legible small-text typesetting.
lessons.example: Opening tracking on 6pt sans-serif ingredient text to prevent physical ink bridging during high-speed flexographic or offset printing.

lessons.lesson_title: Specialized Print Finishes & Spot Color Prepress
lessons.what_is_taught: Prepress color separation for luxury packaging: converting artwork to Pantone Matching System (PMS) spot colors, Spot UV varnish layers, Hot Foil stamping layers set to Overprint, and Total Area Coverage (TAC) limits.
subtopics: Converting brand colors to certified Pantone Formula Guide Solid Coated / Uncoated swatches
Spot UV varnish preparation: 100% black silhouette vector artwork on a dedicated spot layer set to Overprint Fill
Hot Foil stamping: Creating crisp vector paths on a dedicated spot layer for gold/silver/holographic foil dies
Multi-level embossing and debossing: Aligning female and male die artwork with printed graphics
White ink underprinting on metallic foils, kraft paper, and transparent film substrates
lessons.why_it_matters: Specialty embellishments like gold foil and spot varnish transform ordinary packaging into luxury retail goods. Improper layer separation or missing Overprint settings will cause unsightly misregistration halos.
lessons.what_learner_does: Prepare dedicated prepress separation layers in Illustrator for Gold Foil and Spot UV; assign spot colors and verify Overprint settings in the Attributes panel.
lessons.expected_outcome: A production-ready Illustrator file with isolated spot color finish layers correctly configured for commercial plate output.
lessons.example: Setting a Gold Foil spot color layer to Overprint Fill so the underlying background CMYK ink does not punch an empty white knockout hole beneath the foil.

lessons.what_is_taught: Transforming flat 2D dieline artwork into photorealistic 3D packaging packshots in Photoshop, conducting commercial prepress preflighting in Acrobat Pro, and coordinating professional printer handoffs.
subtopics: Mapping 2D flat dieline artwork onto 3D packaging smart-object mockups in Photoshop
Simulating paperboard textures (matte kraft, coated gloss, soft-touch velvet) and metallic foil specular reflections
Preflighting in Adobe Acrobat Pro: Using the Output Preview panel to inspect CMYK plates, spot plates, and total ink coverage (TAC <= 300%)
Printer coordination: Communicating substrate specs, grain direction, fluting, and fold sequences in production briefs
Exporting certified PDF/X-4 print files with crop marks, bleeds, and separation summary documentation
lessons.why_it_matters: Flat dielines are difficult for clients to visualize. Photorealistic 3D packshots sell the concept, while rigorous Acrobat preflight checks catch costly plate errors before the press starts rolling.
lessons.what_learner_does: Render the flat carton artwork into a photorealistic 3D studio packshot with soft shadows and gold foil reflections; audit the final PDF in Acrobat Pro Output Preview.
lessons.expected_outcome: A client-ready 3D packaging visual presentation and a verified, press-ready PDF/X-4 file approved for commercial printing.
lessons.example: Using Acrobat Output Preview to verify that the Spot UV layer appears on its own independent separation plate without contaminating the 4 process CMYK plates.

modules.hands_on_practice: Construct a vector dieline with cut and crease scores, layout packaging graphics across panels, configure a Spot UV plate set to Overprint, and render a 3D packshot.
modules.assignment: Create a print-ready retail carton and label design with supplied dieline, original brand graphics, specialty spot finish separation layers, a photorealistic 3D mockup, and a certified preflight PDF.
modules.business_application: Enables designers to produce commercial retail packaging, FMCG carton artwork, and beverage labels for D2C brands and global manufacturers.
modules.expected_outcome: Submitted Illustrator vector dieline package with dedicated spot finish plates, photorealistic 3D packshots, and verified preflight PDF/X-4.

modules.module_purpose: Master user-centered digital interface design, user journey mapping, information architecture, wireframing, layout spacing, UI typography, and accessible design principles in Figma, establishing strong foundational UI/UX competence.
what_you_will_learn: Differentiate UI visual craft from UX research methodologies and apply human-centered design thinking to product briefs.
Develop user personas, empathy maps, and end-to-end user journey flows that resolve friction points.
Construct clear information architecture, content inventories, and structural sitemaps in FigJam.
Translate paper sketches into low-fidelity digital wireframes adhering to layout grids and visual hierarchy.
Apply the 8-point spatial grid system, UI typography scales, accessible color contrast (WCAG 2.1 AA), and interactive component states.
key_concepts: UI Craft vs UX Research Mindsets

lessons.lesson_title: UX Foundations, User Research & Problem Framing
lessons.what_is_taught: Foundational user experience concepts: UI vs UX, human-centered design thinking (Empathize, Define, Ideate, Prototype, Test), identifying user pain points, basic user research, personas, and competitive benchmarking.
subtopics: The spectrum of digital design: UI visual craft vs UX interaction architecture
The 5 stages of Design Thinking applied to digital product challenges
Conducting lightweight user research: User interviews, observation, and competitive benchmarking
Developing evidence-based User Personas and Empathy Maps
Mapping user journeys: Identifying emotional highs, lows, and high-friction drop-off points
lessons.why_it_matters: A beautiful user interface that solves the wrong problem will fail in the marketplace. Grounding visual design in user research ensures products deliver intuitive commercial utility.
lessons.what_learner_does: Deconstruct a digital service problem (e.g. mobile appointment booking or subscription checkout); create a target user persona and map an end-to-end user journey identifying 3 friction bottlenecks.
lessons.expected_outcome: A documented User Persona sheet and visual User Journey Map highlighting key friction points and opportunities for design intervention.
lessons.example: Identifying that users abandon a booking app because doctor availability is hidden behind a 4-step registration wall.

lessons.what_is_taught: Information architecture (IA) principles: mental models, content inventories, structural sitemaps, task flow diagrams, screen-to-screen user journeys, and navigational hierarchies in FigJam.
subtopics: Mental models and card sorting basics for intuitive content categorization
Building structural sitemaps and navigational trees in FigJam
Designing task flows and user flows with decision gates and error termination states
Navigational hierarchies: Tab bars, bottom navigation, hamburger drawers, and sticky headers
Content inventories: Auditing required content blocks prior to screen design
lessons.why_it_matters: Disorganized information architecture disorients users. Clear sitemaps and task flows guarantee that users can reach their primary goal in the minimum number of intuitive clicks.
lessons.what_learner_does: Map the complete information architecture and screen-to-screen user flow for a digital healthcare or e-commerce platform in FigJam, accounting for happy paths and error states.
lessons.expected_outcome: A structured sitemap and complete user flow diagram connecting landing screen to successful conversion.
lessons.example: Designing a streamlined 3-step checkout user flow that eliminates unnecessary intermediate screens.

lessons.what_is_taught: Translating user flows into wireframe layouts: analog sketch ideation, low-fidelity digital wireframes in Figma, spatial layout mechanics, 8-point spatial grid systems, and responsive column grids.
subtopics: Rapid thumbnail wireframing on paper: Exploring 10 screen layouts in 15 minutes
Building digital low-fidelity wireframes in Figma without visual styling distractions
The 8-point spatial grid system: Spacing, sizing, and padding in multiples of 8 (and 4 for micro-spacing)
Responsive layout column grids: 12-column desktop (1440px) and 4-column mobile (390px)
Visual hierarchy in UI: Guiding visual attention using scale, weight, and spatial grouping
lessons.why_it_matters: Jumping straight into colors and high-fidelity graphics distracts from core structural usability. Low-fidelity wireframing validates layout logic, hierarchy, and content placement rapidly.
lessons.what_learner_does: Convert paper sketches into a 4-screen low-fidelity digital wireframe flow in Figma adhering strictly to an 8pt spatial grid and 12-column responsive layout.
lessons.expected_outcome: A cohesive 4-screen low-fidelity wireframe prototype validating layout proportions, hierarchy, and user flow.
lessons.example: Applying consistent 24px container padding and 16px internal card gutters to ensure harmonious spatial rhythm across all screens.

lessons.lesson_title: UI Visual Polish, Accessibility & Interaction States
lessons.what_is_taught: Transforming wireframes into polished interfaces: UI typography scales, color psychology in UI, accessible contrast compliance (WCAG 2.1 AA), interaction states (default, hover, pressed, disabled), and form patterns.
subtopics: UI typography hierarchy: Establishing display, headline, body, label, and caption styles
Accessible color contrast: WCAG 2.1 AA standards (4.5:1 for body copy, 3:1 for large text and UI controls)
Auditing contrast using plugins (Stark / Contrast Checker) to ensure universal accessibility
Interactive component states: Designing default, hover, focused, active, loading, and disabled states
Form design patterns: Floating labels, inline validation messages, input masks, and clear error recovery
lessons.why_it_matters: Low-contrast text and ambiguous buttons exclude users with visual impairments and cause severe usability failures. Accessible UI design is a legal and ethical commercial requirement.
lessons.what_learner_does: Apply high-fidelity visual styling to the wireframe screens; audit all text contrast against WCAG 2.1 AA; design all interactive states for form inputs and primary buttons.
lessons.expected_outcome: A high-fidelity 4-screen UI interface featuring WCAG-compliant color contrast, refined typography, and documented interactive states.
lessons.example: Refining a muted gray button label from 2.8:1 contrast to an accessible 4.6:1 contrast ratio by adjusting its lightness value.

modules.hands_on_practice: Map an information architecture sitemap in FigJam, build a 4-screen low-fidelity wireframe on an 8pt grid, and audit accessibility contrast.
modules.assignment: Create a comprehensive user flow, low-fidelity wireframes, and polished high-fidelity UI screens for a realistic digital product concept, complete with documented interactive states and WCAG contrast compliance.
modules.business_application: Equips visual designers to transition into junior UI/UX designer and product interface designer roles in tech startups and digital agencies.
modules.expected_outcome: Submitted interactive Figma project file containing user flow diagrams, low-fidelity wireframes, and polished high-fidelity interface screens.

modules.module_purpose: Master scalable design systems, Auto-Layout 5.0, constraints, component properties, Figma Variables (modes), advanced interactive prototyping with Smart Animate, and developer handoff workflows in Figma without requiring coding.
what_you_will_learn: Master Figma Auto-Layout 5.0: direction, padding, gap, hug vs fill vs fixed sizing, min/max dimensions, and wrap.
Adapt interface screens seamlessly across Desktop (1440px), Tablet (768px), and Mobile (390px) responsive breakpoints.
Construct an atomic design system with semantic color tokens, typography styles, and Figma Variables for instant Light/Dark theming.
Build modular Master Components with Variants, Boolean properties, Text properties, and Instance Swaps.
Create high-fidelity interactive prototypes using Smart Animate, spring physics, overlays, and prepare Dev Mode specs for engineering handoff.
key_concepts: Interactive Prototyping with Smart Animate & Springs
AI-Assisted Layout Drafting & Figma Make Guided Exposure

lessons.what_is_taught: The engine of modern interface design: Auto-Layout 5.0 mechanics, direction (vertical, horizontal, wrap), independent padding, gap spacing, alignment, hug contents vs fill container, min/max constraints, and nested hierarchies.
subtopics: Auto-Layout fundamentals: Direction, independent padding (top, right, bottom, left), and gap between items
Resizing constraints: Hug Contents, Fixed Width/Height, and Fill Container mechanics
Min and Max dimensions: Enforcing minimum and maximum container widths to prevent broken layouts
Auto-Layout Wrap: Creating dynamic responsive chip filters and multi-row tag clouds
Nested auto-layout hierarchies: Combining vertical and horizontal frames to construct bulletproof responsive cards
lessons.why_it_matters: Static frame-based designs break the instant text content changes or viewport sizes shrink. Pure auto-layout ensures components flex and reflow dynamically like real browser code.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build a complex e-commerce product card containing an image, badges, ratings, variable-length title, pricing, and button, configured so resizing the card reflows all child elements flawlessly.
lessons.expected_outcome: A fully responsive auto-layout product card that gracefully handles any image aspect ratio and multi-line title text without manual repositioning.
lessons.example: Setting title text to 'Fill Container' so an unexpected 3-line product title pushes the price and CTA downward automatically without overlapping.

lessons.what_is_taught: Foundations of design systems: Atomic Design methodology (Atoms, Molecules, Organisms), design token taxonomy (primitive vs semantic tokens), Figma Variables, and creating instantaneous Light/Dark mode themes.
subtopics: Atomic Design taxonomy: Categorizing UI elements into Atoms, Molecules, and Organisms
Design tokens: Primitive values (e.g. blue-500) vs semantic functional tokens (e.g. bg-primary, text-brand)
Typography styles: Configuring global text styles for Display, Title, Body, and Caption across viewport scales
Figma Variables: Setting up color variables, number variables (spacing/radius), and string variables
Creating Variable Modes: Configuring instant switching between Light Mode and Dark Mode across entire screens
lessons.why_it_matters: Hardcoding hex codes across hundreds of screens makes rebrands and dark mode implementations nightmare projects. Tokenized variables enable system-wide updates in seconds.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build a design token library in Figma containing color, spacing, radius, and typography tokens; configure Variable Modes and demonstrate instant Light-to-Dark theme switching on a dashboard card.
lessons.expected_outcome: A structured Figma Variable collection and a dashboard UI screen that flips between Light and Dark modes with zero manual recoloring.
lessons.example: Binding background frames to a semantic 'surface/container' token that resolves to #FFFFFF in Light Mode and #1E293B in Dark Mode.

lessons.what_is_taught: Engineering scalable UI component libraries: Main Components vs Instances, Component Variants for state management, Component Properties (Boolean, Text, Instance Swap), and library publishing.
subtopics: Main Components vs Instances: Override hygiene, resetting overrides, and component detachment rules
Component Variants: Organizing multi-state components (Default, Hover, Active, Disabled, Loading)
Component Properties: Boolean properties to toggle icons, Text properties for instant copy editing
Instance Swap properties: Enabling one-click icon swapping from a centralized icon library
Building complex molecules: Form inputs with trailing icons, dropdown select menus, and modal dialogs
lessons.why_it_matters: Without component properties, design files become bloated with hundreds of redundant detached variants. Component properties reduce variant counts by up to 80% while maximizing team efficiency.
lessons.what_learner_does: Engineer an atomic button component featuring 4 visual variants (Primary, Secondary, Ghost, Danger), 5 interactive states, boolean icon toggles, and instance swap properties.
lessons.expected_outcome: A unified master component with clean property controls published in an organized Figma component library.
lessons.example: Toggling a 'showLeadingIcon' boolean switch in the Figma inspector to instantly show or hide an icon without detaching the component.

lessons.lesson_title: Interactive Prototyping, Smart Animate & Dev Handoff
lessons.what_is_taught: High-fidelity prototyping and developer handoff: Smart Animate transitions, cubic bezier easing, spring physics, scroll interactions, overlays, Figma Dev Mode inspection, and token documentation.
subtopics: Prototype connections: Triggers (On Click, While Hovering, Drag), Actions (Navigate, Open Overlay, Scroll To)
Smart Animate mechanics: Layer naming matching, frame hierarchy rules, and fluid shape morphing
Custom easing curves: Tuning cubic bezier curves and spring physics for natural tactile UI feedback
Designing responsive breakpoints: Desktop (1440px), Tablet (768px), and Mobile (390px) screen adaptation
Developer Mode (Dev Mode): Inspecting CSS/iOS/Android code, token mapping, exporting assets, and Figma Make exposure
lessons.why_it_matters: Static mockups cannot communicate spatial timing, page transitions, or micro-interactions. Interactive prototypes simulate real software feel and eliminate developer misinterpretation.
lessons.what_learner_does: Build an interactive multi-screen responsive prototype featuring animated accordion drawers, swipeable mobile carousels, and a sticky header; prepare Dev Mode handoff documentation.
lessons.expected_outcome: A functioning Figma prototype link demonstrating responsive behavior, smooth micro-interactions, and documented component specifications for developers.
lessons.example: Using Smart Animate between two screens to smoothly expand a collapsed mobile card into a full-screen detailed view with matching layer names.

modules.hands_on_practice: Build an auto-layout responsive card, establish a semantic variable collection with Light/Dark mode, create a variant button system, and prototype a Smart Animate flow.
modules.assignment: Develop a responsive website UI for desktop (1440px) and mobile (390px) featuring reusable design-system components, variable modes, and a working interactive prototype with Dev Mode handoff notes.
modules.business_application: Prepares visual and UI designers to collaborate with frontend engineering teams, maintain scalable design systems, and deliver production-ready digital product prototypes.
modules.expected_outcome: Submitted interactive Figma file link with documented design tokens, reusable components, responsive screen layouts, and a functioning prototype.

modules.module_purpose: Master motion design principles, kinetic typography, animated brand identity stings, social media motion graphics, Speed Graph velocity curves, and lightweight web Lottie JSON exports in Adobe After Effects without requiring deep VFX or full video editing.
what_you_will_learn: Apply the 12 principles of animation (squash & stretch, anticipation, follow-through, staging) to abstract vector graphics and brand marks.
Sculpt custom easing curves in the After Effects Speed Graph to achieve organic deceleration and punchy dynamic motion.
Build kinetic typography sequences using text animators, Range Selectors, and audio beat synchronization.
Convert layered Adobe Illustrator vector logos into native shape layers and build a commercial 4-second logo reveal sting.
Export optimized MP4 video reels for social advertising and lightweight vector Lottie JSON animations for web integration.
key_concepts: 12 Principles of Animation in Brand Motion
Social Media MP4 & Bodymovin Lottie JSON Export

lessons.lesson_title: Motion Foundations & Speed Graph Curve Sculpting
lessons.what_is_taught: The language of motion: applying the 12 principles of animation to graphic design, composition settings (frame rates: 24fps cinematic, 30fps social, 60fps UI), keyframe types (linear vs bezier vs hold), and Speed Graph velocity curve sculpting.
subtopics: The 12 principles of animation adapted for modern brand motion design
Composition setup: Frame rates (24fps vs 30fps vs 60fps), resolutions (1080x1920 vertical, 1920x1080 horizontal), and pixel aspect ratios
Transform properties: Anchor Point placement, Position, Scale, Rotation, and Opacity
Keyframe interpolation: Moving beyond linear keyframes using Easy Ease (F9) and continuous bezier handles
The Speed Graph Editor: Reading velocity curves, creating exponential deceleration, and snapping pop-ins
lessons.why_it_matters: Linear, mechanical motion looks robotic and amateur. Sculpting custom velocity curves in the Speed Graph gives graphics natural physical weight, personality, and cinematic polish.
lessons.what_learner_does: Animate a bouncing ball morphing into a geometric square and star; adjust velocity curves in the Speed Graph until the bounce demonstrates convincing squash, stretch, and momentum.
lessons.expected_outcome: An animation study demonstrating mastery of the Speed Graph, realistic easing curves, and spatial interpolation.
lessons.example: Pulling the right velocity handle in the Speed Graph to create an aggressive 85% ease-in, making an object snap onto screen rapidly and decelerate smoothly.

lessons.what_is_taught: Vector motion in After Effects: shape layer mechanics, vector paths, shape layer operators (Trim Paths, Repeater, Pucker & Bloat, Wiggle Transform), Alpha Mattes, Luma Mattes, and geometric transitions.
subtopics: Shape layer anatomy: Contents, groups, paths, strokes, and fills
Trim Paths operator: Creating animated line drawings, progressing outlines, and self-drawing borders
Repeater and Wiggle Transform: Generating dynamic particle bursts, radial arrays, and decorative motion flourishes
Alpha Mattes and Luma Mattes: Revealing text and graphics through geometric windows and organic textures
Parenting and Null Objects: Building hierarchical animation rigs for complex multi-element choreographies
lessons.why_it_matters: Shape layer operators allow designers to create intricate motion graphics with tiny file footprints and infinite vector scalability, perfect for modern brand animations.
lessons.what_learner_does: Construct a dynamic geometric transition wipe using Trim Paths, a radial Repeater burst, and an Alpha Matte window to reveal a product photo.
lessons.expected_outcome: A seamless 3-second geometric vector transition sequence built entirely with native shape layers and mattes.
lessons.example: Staggering the 'Start' and 'End' parameters of Trim Paths to create an energetic laser-line drawing effect along a vector path.

lessons.what_is_taught: Typography in motion: kinetic text animation, text animators (Position, Scale, Tracking, Opacity, Blur), Range Selectors, Wiggly Selectors, audio beat markers, and 15-second social promotional motion reels.
subtopics: Text animator architecture: Adding properties (Tracking, Blur, Position, Rotation) to text layers
Range Selectors: Manipulating Start, End, and Offset; animating by characters, words, or lines
Advanced typography motion: Easing High/Low, Randomize Order, and smooth typewriter effects
Importing audio files: Visualizing audio waveforms, dropping markers (tap * key) on musical beats and voiceover cadence
Designing 15-second vertical promotional reels (1080x1920) synchronized to an energetic commercial voiceover
lessons.why_it_matters: Kinetic typography commands high attention on mobile social feeds where users watch with audio on or off. Animated typography delivers high-converting marketing messages rapidly.
lessons.what_learner_does: Animate a dynamic 15-second promotional social media video reel using staggered text range animators synchronized precisely to voiceover audio and rhythmic beat markers.
lessons.expected_outcome: A finished 1080x1920 kinetic typography social promotional reel with tight audio synchronization and expressive easing.
lessons.example: Animating Tracking from +150 to 0 while blurring in from 20px on word boundaries to create an impactful cinematic title reveal.

lessons.lesson_title: Brand Identity Reveals, Rendering & Lottie Web Export
lessons.what_is_taught: Commercial logo animation: importing layered Adobe Illustrator files into After Effects, converting vectors to native shape layers, designing a 4-second logo sting, Adobe Media Encoder MP4 rendering, and Bodymovin Lottie JSON export.
subtopics: Preparing vector logos in Illustrator: Layer naming, grouping, and importing as Composition - Retain Layer Sizes
Converting vector layers to native shape layers: Advantages and resolving conversion path bugs
Designing the 4-second commercial logo sting: Staging, abstract mark buildup, character reveal, and lockup shine
Rendering pipelines: Adobe Media Encoder, MP4 (H.264), bitrate optimization for Instagram / TikTok
Exporting for the web with Bodymovin / LottieFiles: Generating clean, lightweight vector JSON animations for web developers
lessons.why_it_matters: Brands in 2026 need animated logos for YouTube bumpers, digital signage, and app splash screens. Lottie JSON exports allow vector animations to render in code at $<150\text{ KB}$ without heavy video files.
lessons.what_learner_does: Import their Module 03/04 brand logo; animate a 4-second commercial logo reveal sting; export an MP4 social video and a validated Lottie JSON web animation file.
lessons.expected_outcome: A professional 4-second commercial logo sting MP4 video and a validated lightweight Lottie JSON animation rendering natively in browsers.
lessons.example: Exporting a complex logo reveal via Bodymovin resulting in an 85 KB Lottie JSON file that loads instantly on a mobile web landing page.

modules.hands_on_practice: Sculpt velocity curves in the Speed Graph, create Trim Paths vector bursts, sync kinetic text to audio beats, and export a Lottie JSON file.
modules.assignment: Create a professional 4-second branded logo reveal sting and a 15-second vertical social promotional video reel (1080x1920 MP4) with sound effects, accompanied by a validated web Lottie JSON export.
modules.business_application: Prepares visual designers to deliver high-demand brand motion graphics, social video ad creative, and web micro-interactions for digital agencies and tech products.
modules.expected_outcome: Submitted 1080x1920 MP4 video files with polished graph editor easing and an error-free Lottie JSON vector animation file.

modules.module_title: Generative AI for Creative Production & Art Direction
modules.module_purpose: Master commercially responsible generative AI as an advanced art direction pipeline, combining structured visual prompt engineering, style/character consistency, Adobe Firefly, Photoshop/Illustrator generative tools, and rigorous manual human-in-the-loop post-processing with strict IP copyright governance.
what_you_will_learn: Operate generative AI as a specialized creative assistant under human art direction, avoiding generic raw outputs.
Master visual prompt engineering: specifying photographic lenses, lighting setups, materials, color palettes, and aspect ratios.
Maintain aesthetic style consistency across multi-asset campaigns using Style Reference (--sref) and Character/Object Reference (--cref).
Integrate Photoshop Generative Fill/Expand and Illustrator Text to Vector/Recolor within commercial production workflows.
Navigate intellectual property, client confidentiality, commercial licensing indemnification, and C2PA Content Credentials provenance.
key_concepts: Human-Directed Art Direction vs Raw AI Output
Illustrator Text to Vector & Generative Recolor
Comparative Model Workflows (Firefly, ChatGPT, Gemini, Midjourney)
Responsible AI Design, Copyright Law & C2PA Provenance

lessons.lesson_title: AI Creative Direction, Prompt Architecture & Moodboards
lessons.what_is_taught: The art direction imperative in generative AI: moving beyond casual prompts to disciplined commercial art direction, creative brief deconstruction, structured visual prompt architecture, model selection, and Firefly Boards moodboarding.
subtopics: The 2026 Creative Director's mandate: Human-directed art direction vs unguided generic AI output
Anatomy of an agency visual prompt: Subject, Medium, Environment, Lighting, Color Palette, Camera Lens, and Aspect Ratio
Photographic art direction: Specifying focal lengths (35mm, 85mm, macro 100mm) and lighting setups (Rembrandt, volumetric, chiaroscuro)
Materiality and tactile textures: Matte ceramic, brushed titanium, cast resin, iridescent glass, and woven textiles
Curating generative concept boards and visual stylescapes using Adobe Firefly Boards and moodboarding frameworks
lessons.why_it_matters: Vague prompts produce generic, cliché AI imagery. Creative directors who specify photographic optics, cinematic lighting, and tactile materials achieve precise, commercially viable concept imagery.
lessons.what_learner_does: Deconstruct a luxury product brief; author 6 structured photographic prompts specifying exact lighting and lens parameters; curate a 9-tile Firefly moodboard establishing the campaign art direction.
lessons.expected_outcome: A documented prompt architecture log and a curated commercial moodboard board establishing unified art direction for a campaign.
lessons.example: Directing a cosmetic shot: 'Macro 100mm lens, f/2.8, frosted glass dropper bottle on wet slate, soft diffuse studio lighting, cool pastel tones, mist particles, --ar 16:9'.

lessons.what_is_taught: Aesthetic consistency across campaign touchpoints: Style Reference (--sref), Character Reference (--cref), object consistency, region inpainting, outpainting (zoom/expand), and reference-guided generation.
subtopics: Style Reference (--sref) mechanics: Transferring color, mood, and aesthetic texture across disparate prompt subjects
Character Reference (--cref) and object consistency: Preserving facial features, wardrobe, and custom product silhouettes
Region inpainting (Vary Region / Generative Fill): Modifying localized details while preserving the surrounding composition
Outpainting and re-framing: Expanding compositions horizontally and vertically for multi-aspect ratio campaign adaptation
